# Results (generated by scripts/make_results_md.py from saved JSON files; do not edit by hand)

## 1. Detectors (BePLi v2 official splits; 1280 px; conf 0.001; NMS IoU 0.6; max 400 detections)

| Model | Split | Precision | Recall | mAP50 | mAP50-95 |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| YOLO11s | val | 0.313 | 0.344 | 0.263 | 0.162 |
| YOLO11s | test | 0.299 | 0.301 | 0.237 | 0.144 |
| YOLO11m | val | 0.334 | 0.362 | 0.291 | 0.182 |
| YOLO11m | test | 0.307 | 0.333 | 0.252 | 0.157 |

One training run per model, so the YOLO11s / YOLO11m gap is a single-run difference, not a significance test. About 89% of annotated boxes are smaller than 32x32 px (dataset audit), which keeps absolute mAP low.

## 2. Tile-priority ranking (test split, 610 images with at least 5 ground-truth tiles; 6x8 grid)

| Method | Spearman | Top-5 overlap |
|---|---:|---:|
| random ranking | -0.007 | 0.095 |
| detector-only planner score | 0.531 | 0.524 |
| tile MLP (no tile context) (20,737 params) | 0.660 +- 0.001 | 0.590 +- 0.001 |
| route-context transformer (71,233 params) | 0.661 +- 0.001 | 0.591 +- 0.002 |

Transformer minus tile MLP: +0.001 Spearman (seed standard deviation about 0.001). Labels are ground-truth boxes weighted by the same class weights as the heuristic, so this measures agreement with a proxy, not real cleanup efficiency.

## 3. VAE vs PCA (64 latent dims; 12000 train crops, 3000 held-out val crops; PCA output clipped to [0,1])

| Measure | VAE | PCA |
|---|---:|---:|
| reconstruction MSE per pixel | 0.01193 | 0.01132 |
| 5-NN class accuracy in latent space | 0.181 | 0.190 |

Train-majority-class baseline for 5-NN accuracy: 0.197.
Reconstruction: the VAE is not better than PCA.
Class information: both latent spaces score at or below the majority-class baseline, so they carry little class information at this setting.

## 4. DCGAN copy check (80 epochs; pixel-space L2 to the nearest training crop, scale [-1, 1])

| | median | minimum |
|---|---:|---:|
| generated (256 samples) | 33.0 | 16.0 |
| real held-out val crops (256) | 35.4 | 11.3 |

Share of generated samples closer to a training crop than every real val crop: 0.0%. No sign of memorisation by this crude pixel-space check.
No FID or other learned-feature metric was computed; sample quality is judged visually (results/generative/gan_samples.png).
